name: Raymond
source: Raymond was a guardian angel who was assigned to protect the Felicitas family, where the head of the family was a priest with great connections in religion. But Raymond could not save them and fell from heaven, losing some of his powers and angelic appearance. Having acquired a physical form, he found the ghost of Ariana, who could not calm down and continued to wander the earth. Raymond also didn't know the cause of the Felicitas' death, so they decided to investigate together. At the moment, he lives in a house rented by Laurence Bremer. Raymond works as a waiter at Cassandra's bar. While working, he studies the world of people from a different angle and learns his new essence.
